raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions contains 26 re-delivered rows with record_version=2 for txn_ids that already exist at version 1, so silver has duplicate txn_ids. The fix keeps only the latest version per txn_id and applies the POSTED filter after that, so a v2 REVERSED row correctly removes the transaction instead of leaving the stale v1 POSTED row.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
